purpose: Immutable audit record of the initial provisioning of rope-testnet-1, including firewall bring-up, SSH bring-up, and matched-glibc verification. The operational manifest at rope-testnet-1.provision.json is regenerated on every idempotent re-run of provision-testnet-droplet.sh and does NOT retain historical detail; this file does.

firewall.name: rope-testnet-fw
firewall.created_via: manual DigitalOcean API POST after provision-testnet-droplet.sh v1 silently lost the id in its py_extract helper

provisioner_bug_recorded_and_fixed.symptom: Initial run said 'created firewall ' (empty id) and continued; droplet came up without cloud-layer firewall until manual reconciliation.
provisioner_bug_recorded_and_fixed.root_cause: curl POST /firewalls succeeded but the response wasn't captured; py_extract ran against a pipe that had already been consumed by the redirect, so FW_ID ended up empty; script continued.
fix_summary: Capture full POST response body into FW_RESP before extracting id
If FW_ID is empty after extraction, print the response body and exit 1
Attach step now checks the response for an error object and bails
After attach, GET /firewalls/{FW_ID} and assert droplet_ids includes the target droplet - hard fail if not
provisioner_bug_recorded_and_fixed.reverified_by: Re-running the script at 2026-08-31T09:24:55Z: 'firewall exists: 7e279b17...', 'droplet rope-testnet-1 exists', 'firewall attach verified: droplet 596549440 is behind rope-testnet-fw'.
